landing.heroTitle: Evolve how you learn, work and lead.
landing.heroSubtitle: The platform that evolves with you: organize your information, and generate summaries, flow diagrams and practice quizzes with exact citations.

landing.featuresTitle: From a note to an action
landing.f1Title: Automatic storage and organization by subject
landing.f1Body: Notes, files and tasks stay grouped by subject or project, ready to search.
landing.f2Body: A note becomes a summary or a diagram, always tied to the original sentence.
landing.f3Title: Practice quizzes for exams and meetings
landing.f3Body: Prepare a test or a meeting with questions drawn from your own materials.
landing.f4Title: A tutor with direct textual citations
landing.f4Body: Every claim points at the exact quote. If the note does not say it, the tutor does not invent it.
landing.howTitle: From student to professional to team
landing.how1: Prepare exams, build study guides and synthesize your classes.
landing.how2: Turn meeting notes, briefings and documents into an analysis with sources.
landing.how3: Share subjects and projects with your team. Your personal ledger stays private: the team tutor reads only what was published.
landing.privacyBody: Your notes, uploaded files and questions to the tutor are strictly private to your account, are never shared with third parties and are never used to train public AI models.
landing.footer: Powered by Supabase and OpenAI. Your data stays isolated to your account.

legal.disclaimer: This document is a general template and should be reviewed by qualified legal counsel before commercial use.
legal.termsIntro: These Terms of Service govern your use of Smart Learning Ledger. Please read them carefully.
legal.privacyIntro: Your privacy is the foundation of this product. This policy explains exactly what we process and, above all, what we never do.
legal.t1Body: By creating an account or using the service you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
legal.t2Body: Smart Learning Ledger lets you log notes, meetings, documents and tasks organised by subject or project, and ask an AI tutor questions that are answered only from your own content, with source citations.
legal.t3Body: You must be at least 16 years old and provide accurate information. You are responsible for keeping your password confidential and for all activity under your account. Tell us immediately if you suspect unauthorised access.
legal.t4Body: Everything you write or upload (notes, files, attachments and your questions to the tutor) remains yours. You grant us only the limited permission needed to store, index and process it for you in order to operate the service. We claim no other rights over it.
legal.t5Body: The tutor is designed to answer strictly from your own notes and to cite its sources, and its citations are checked automatically. It can still be incomplete or wrong, for example if your notes are. It does not provide professional, medical, legal or financial advice. Verify important information against the original sources.
legal.t6Body: Do not use the service to break the law, infringe the rights of others, upload content you have no right to use, attempt to access other users' data, disrupt the service or reverse engineer it.
legal.t7Body: Your content is strictly private, isolated by account, never shared with third parties and never used to train public AI models. The details are in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms.
legal.t8Body: We work to keep the service available but provide it "as is", without guarantees of uninterrupted operation. To the extent permitted by law, we are not liable for indirect or consequential damages or for losses caused by relying on AI-generated answers. Keep your own backups of important material.
legal.t9Body: You may stop using the service and delete your entries, files or entire account at any time. We may suspend accounts that seriously breach these Terms. When content is deleted, its attachments and search index are deleted with it.
legal.t10Body: We may update these Terms. If the changes are material we will notify you in the app or by email. Continuing to use the service after that means you accept the new Terms.
legal.p1Body: Your notes, uploaded files and questions to the tutor are strictly private. They are isolated by account, are never shared with third parties and are never used to train public AI models. We do not sell your data and we do not show advertising.
legal.p2Body: Account data (email, name, role, field of study or work, preferred language and time zone); the content you create (notes, tags, attachments and the text extracted from them); the numeric search representations (embeddings) generated from that content; and the questions you ask the tutor and its answers.
legal.p3Body: Only to provide the service to you: to store your ledger, index it so it can be searched, retrieve the passages relevant to a question and generate a grounded answer for you. We do not use your content for any other purpose, such as profiling, advertising or analytics about you.
legal.p4Body: Every record is bound to your account and protected by database-level Row Level Security. Your files live in a private storage area that only you can access. The tutor can only retrieve your own content and never that of other users, and other users can never retrieve yours.
legal.p5Title: 5. No sharing and no AI training
legal.p5Body: We never share your content with third parties for their own purposes and we never use it to train public AI models. To operate the service we rely on technical processors, Supabase (database, authentication and storage) and OpenAI (text embeddings, transcription and answer generation through its API). They process your data only on our behalf and to provide the service, and under their API terms your data is not used to train their models; the AI provider may keep API data temporarily for abuse monitoring as described in its terms.
legal.p6Body: We only use strictly necessary cookies: the secure session cookie that keeps you signed in and a cookie that remembers your language. We use no advertising or cross-site tracking cookies.
legal.p7Body: We keep your data while your account is active. If you delete an entry, its attachment, extracted text and embeddings are deleted too. If you delete your account, all of your data is removed.
legal.p8Body: We protect data with encrypted connections, encryption at rest provided by our infrastructure, per-account access control and least-privilege credentials. No system is perfectly secure, but we take reasonable measures and will notify you of incidents that affect you as required by law.
legal.p9Body: You can access, correct, export and delete your data, and object to or limit its processing, at any time. You can do most of this yourself in the app, and you can contact us for anything else.
legal.p10Body: If we change this policy in a way that reduces your privacy protections we will ask for your consent or notify you in advance. The date of the latest update is shown at the top.
